Welcome
​​ ​​​​Kingsmoor Primary School is situated in the village of Bawdrip and opened in February 1995. The school serves the communities of Bawdrip, Chedzoy, Bridgwater and nearby villages. ​​​We hope you find our website informative and useful. Hard copies of all information are available from the school office, details of which can be found on our contact page.

Headteacher's Message
​Welcome to Kingsmoor Primary school’s website! It is with great pleasure that I write as the Headteacher of Kingsmoor Primary School. Kingsmoor is a very special school where positive relationships are nurtured with each child and family and immense pride is taken in ‘looking after each other,’ ‘our whole school and everything in it.’ Our Kingsmoor code underpins the high expectations we have for all children, striving for excellence and ensuring every child is provided with a journey that enables them to flourish as individuals and independent learners - being encouraged to ‘try their best in everything they do and being friendly and polite towards each other.’ I welcome you to explore our website to give you a flavour of our school and the provision which we offer - the deep and rich curriculum which enables each child to grow socially, emotionally and academically - embracing talents and promoting aspirational learning by immersing each child with a wide range of opportunities and memorable experiences that may spark future interests or open their minds!!I fully appreciate that choosing the correct school for your child is such an important step and welcome you to make contact with us if you have any questions or queries. Please contact the school office if you would like to arrange a visit - I look forward to welcoming you! Mrs Joanne Warren

Mental Fluency:At Kingsmoor, we strongly believe that the quick recall and understanding of key number facts is essential for children to become successful mathematicians. We teach daily fluency sessions with the aim that children can recall these facts quickly and accurately, whilst recognising when and how to use an efficient mental method to work out a calculation and when a written method is needed.
Kingsmoor Mental Fluency Policy
To ensure that children are confident in using written strategies to perform calculations, we follow our written calculation policy for progression throughout the school. Children practise each written strategy frequently to ensure that they can use them fluently and efficiently in each year group.

SEND Policy SEND Accessibility Plan Our school's ELSAs, Mrs Butcher and Miss Mitchell support the pupils with their emotions. Please talk to the class teacher if you feel your child would benefit from support in this area. Areas where support is given includes: resilience, self-esteem, regulation or emotions, bereavement, family circumstances changing to name a few. This is a short term intervention with a key adult. Additional therapy groups are also run by Miss Mitchell which include: Lego therapy, play therapy and friendship/social groups.
